column2: [intro]
In my kitchen, I put on my apron,
Ready to cook, to experiment, and play on.
Grilled eggplants and melting spinach too,
In my lasagna, it's a delight so true.
Oh, vegetarian lasagna, it’s my passion so grand,
When I make it, it’s an explosion so planned.
With fresh veggies and colors bright,
I invite you all to taste my delight.
Crisp zucchini and roasted peppers blend,
It's the gourmet touch, on which I depend.
A light béchamel, creamy as can be,
My vegetarian lasagna, you’ll love it, you’ll see.
Oh, I love to cook, lasagna’s my pride,
A recipe of love, my guests will be satisfied.
With a touch of Parmesan, it’s the peak of taste,
Vegetarian lasagna, a delightful overdose with no waste.
[solo]
Oh, vegetarian lasagna, it’s my passion so grand,
When I make it, it’s an explosion so planned.
With fresh veggies and colors bright,
I invite you all to taste my delight.
